##### Project general facts

The Baltimore by Nshama presents a range of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments designed for contemporary living in the vibrant community. The residence formats include apartments with boulevard views offered from each unit, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The development aims to provide a balanced environment suitable for various lifestyles, offering a home where modern elegance meets everyday comfort.

Residents enjoy a wealth of amenities designed to enhance daily life, including children's and adult swimming pools, gyms, indoor and outdoor play areas, BBQ areas, and multipurpose rooms. A pet washroom adds convenience for pet owners, while the proximity to the main park provides access to jogging and cycling trails. The community emphasizes convenience and recreational opportunities, creating a vibrant and dynamic living experience.

The Baltimore features modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Interiors boast ample natural light, porcelain flooring, and kitchens with generous counter and storage space. The kitchen is equipped with German-made appliances, and apartments are semi-furnished with built-in wardrobes, ensuring a seamless blend of style and functionality.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within Town Square Dubai, a vibrant and expansive mega-development in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a perfect setting for a healthy and peaceful lifestyle. The picturesque Town Square Park serves as the central hub, featuring lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas that create a sense of unity and community spirit.

The location is distinguished by its host of exceptional facilities and amenities, including sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, retail and dining outlets, and a Town Square Mall with a variety of shops and entertainment options. The strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai, while proximity to schools, hospitals, and essential services offers a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary living, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Town Square Dubai delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
